flags: Venue abroad (Costa Rica): the venue quotes in US dollars. Our Bay Area price sheet does not apply abroad: lines the venue has not priced show unknown (ask the venue or a local supplier).
The per-guest price is the venue's own total divided by its guest count. That total may already include service and tax, so the sheet's service charge and sales tax lines may count them twice. Ask.
